title: Landmark & Van Dorn
meta_title: Dentist near Landmark & Van Dorn, Alexandria | WA Dental Care
meta_description: About ten minutes from the Landmark and Van Dorn area of Alexandria's West End via Duke Street or I-395 to West Alexandria Dental Care.
h1: Your dentist near Landmark and Van Dorn
intro: The West End around Landmark and Van Dorn Street is dense with apartments and condos, Metro commuters and families who need a dentist that takes their insurance, speaks their language and is open when they are off work. We are about ten minutes away via Duke Street or I-395, in the Bradlee Office Building, with free parking and hours from 7 AM to 8 PM on weekdays plus weekend mornings.

sections.heading: Who we see from the West End
body: Families in the apartment communities along Duke Street and Van Dorn Street, many with Virginia Medicaid for the children and a PPO plan or no insurance for the adults. Commuters who use the Van Dorn Metro station and want an evening appointment on the way home. Spanish-speaking and Arabic-speaking households who would rather discuss a treatment plan in their own language, which they can here. And a good number of people who have not had a dentist since moving to the area.
See [Virginia Medicaid](/new-patients/medicaid/), [languages we speak](/new-patients/languages/) and [no insurance?](/new-patients/no-insurance/) for the practical details.

items.title: Via Duke Street
items.body: East on Duke Street, then north on Quaker Lane to W. Braddock Road. The Bradlee Office Building is beside Bradlee Shopping Center.

items.title: Via I-395
items.body: North on I-395 to the King Street exit, toward Alexandria, then W. Braddock Road.

items.title: Via Seminary Road
items.body: From the northern part of the West End, east on Seminary Road to Quaker Lane and W. Braddock Road.

items.title: Parking
items.body: Free surface parking around the building. No garage.

sections.heading: What West End patients most often come in for

items.title: Children's dentistry with Medicaid
items.body: First visits, sealants, fluoride and fillings for children covered by Virginia Medicaid.

items.title: Care without insurance
items.body: Written estimates before anything starts, priorities explained, and treatment staged to fit.

items.title: Emergency care
items.body: Toothache, swelling or a broken tooth seen the same day, including weekend mornings.

items.title: Dentures and tooth replacement
items.body: Partials, full dentures, relines and implant options, with the choice explained in your language.

sections.heading: Practical things worth knowing
items: Open 7 AM to 8 PM Monday to Friday and 8 AM to 1 PM on Saturday and Sunday.
Aetna, Ameritas, Delta Dental, Humana, Cigna, MetLife and Virginia Medicaid accepted.
Care in English, Arabic, Spanish and Portuguese. Mention your language when booking.
Paperwork completed online, on a phone, through the {{forms}}.
Booking online around the clock, or by phone at {{phone}}.

sections.heading: Medicaid patients are patients
sections.body: Same dentists, same hours, same rooms, same written plan. There is no separate schedule or waiting list for Virginia Medicaid. Bring your card and we confirm coverage before the visit.

faqs.q: Do you take Virginia Medicaid for adults as well as children?
faqs.a: We accept Virginia Medicaid. Adult and child benefits differ, and coverage details change, so we check your specific coverage before the visit and tell you what applies.

faqs.q: Can I speak Spanish or Arabic at my appointment?
faqs.a: Yes. Tell us your preferred language when you book so the right team member is scheduled. Dr. Fadi Alhrashi speaks Arabic.

faqs.q: How do I get there from the Van Dorn Metro?
faqs.a: By car it is about ten minutes via Duke Street and Quaker Lane. Bus routes along Duke Street and Quaker Lane also pass near Bradlee Shopping Center; check the current schedule.

faqs.q: I have no insurance. What will a visit cost?
faqs.a: We tell you before you book. An exam and X-rays have a set fee, and any treatment is quoted in writing before it starts. Ask about payment options when you call.

cta.heading: Ten minutes from the West End, in your language.
cta.body: Book online at any hour or call, and tell us which language you would like.
